brief:
The occupied West Bank and Jerusalem have witnessed a notable and qualitative escalation in Palestinian resistance operations following the October 7 Al-Aqsa Flood operation, Shehab Wire reported. Resistance groups have shifted tactics to employ heavy explosive devices and gunfire operations.

The timing of the escalation coincides with the major cross-border attack launched on October 7, 2023, which marked a significant shift in the nature and intensity of Palestinian armed activity in the West Bank.

title: West Bank resistance escalates with heavy explosives after October 7
